title: Daily News Brief — Nov 13, 2026: DTCC adds Solana to its tokenization roadmap
summary:
Friday edition covering Thursday, November 12 through Friday morning, November 13, 2026. DTCC says DTC-tokenized securities will come to Solana in the second half of 2027, joining Stellar and Circle's Arc on its 2027 roadmap ahead of Ethereum mainnet, a bid to meet the venues and stablecoin liquidity where they already sit. Visa adds Western Union's USDPT, issued by Anchorage Digital Bank on Solana, as a native VisaNet settlement asset, with a framework for more Anchorage-issued stablecoins. Securitize and Ethena switch on a $100 million 24/7 liquidity facility that swaps BlackRock's BUIDL into USDC outside market hours, and Hong Kong's SFC says tokenization is moving from experimentation to commercialization. Also: the Czech National Bank's first DLT bond trials including repo, BNY adding staking with Figment, a report that Nomura may sell Laser Digital, and what to watch before the OKX ICE launch.

title: Daily News Brief — Nov 11, 2026: Banks put $270 million behind Project Faro stablecoin

title: Daily News Brief — Nov 10, 2026: NYSE picks Avalanche to settle its tokenized stock platform
summary:

NYSE picks Avalanche technology for the clearing and settlement ledger of its planned 24/7 tokenized securities platform, keeping matching on Pillar and running settlement on a private, permissioned chain controlled by its clearing affiliate, a design that sets up a clear alternative to the DTC-centered model. The transfer agent becomes the battleground: Morgan Stanley buys digital-native Vinyl Equity, StoneX calls Bullish's pending Equiniti deal a toll booth for tokenized shares, and Securitize reports $5 billion in average tokenized assets and agrees to buy stablecoin-funded warehouse lender River One. The ECB, European Commission and ESMA open a call for an industry-chaired European Tokenisation Standards Group, and Progmat and Digital Asset sign an MOU for tokenized JGBs on Canton with repo and collateral connectivity on the roadmap. Also: Formation's Solana venue under the SEC innovation exemption, Robinhood breaking ranks on OKX ICE, PNC and Coinbase on USDC receipts, stablecoin supply at $294.8 billion, Canada's budget on bank-issued stablecoins, New Zealand's stablecoin consultation, the FCA opening applications for wholesale banks' crypto activities, Elizabeth Warren's Senate Banking agenda, Membrane Labs and USDM1, BitGo's Q3 call, and Stripe's miPlata stablecoin card.
